race.comment: MAGIC ROYALE (4) has been thereabouts both times from a spell. Can easily stake a big claim in this if having the right luck early on. PURE WARRIOR (7) raced a lot closer when resuming. That proved a good move with the mare not far away. If they ride her the same, she should be right in the finish. MONEY BAGS (5) will be a huge betting watch into this debut. Has had two trial wins so will have gained plenty of confidence from that. Follow that market. HAZARDOUS (9) Redente filly from Operose on debut. Easy trial winner and well placed to make an immediate impact. BON OVER (1) is another who brings in the sort of trialling that warrants respect. The gate might be a slight concern.
